overview.description: The Bitwise XRP ETF (XRP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long xrp, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to the daily price movements, net of expenses, of the US dollar price of XRP (XRP) through an ETF structure. The Custodian holds XRPs in cold storage (offline) XRP was launched on Nov 19, 2025 and is issued by Bitwise.
